subject: Biotechnology
title: Biological Logic Gates
description: A micro-lesson that makes Biological Logic Gates usable.

hook.text: AND, OR, NOT — silicon computers use logic gates, and so can living cells. Biological computing is real.

buildup.text: Genetic circuits use promoters as inputs and fluorescent proteins as outputs — if two signals are present, the cell glows.

discovery.text: MIT's 2019 cell computer performed 12-bit computation inside E. coli — the most complex genetic logic circuit ever built.

twist.text: Biological circuits are noisy — molecular fluctuations cause errors that silicon transistors would never make.

climax.text: CRISPR-based logic gates store computation results in DNA — permanent records of cellular decisions written into the genome.

punchline.text: Cells that compute — biological logic gates process information inside living organisms.

quiz.question: What is a key disadvantage of biological logic gates compared to silicon?
options: They cannot perform AND or OR operations
Molecular noise causes errors that silicon transistors would not make, reducing computational reliability
They require external electricity to function
